method.imagery: PlanetScope 8-band surface reflectance harmonised to Sentinel-2, one clear day per month, 3 m (agents/planet.py, D12)
method.water: NDWI (green, NIR) > 0 on Planet's UDM2 clear pixels; cloud / haze / no data is no data
method.position: as Phase 11 on the same transects, samples every 5 m read at 3 m: landward edge of the sea-connected water (3 land samples in a row)
method.tide: one day per month is one tide level (several m range, D11): positions are compared, not fitted for rates
method.compare_month: Planet minus the Phase 11 monthly radar position, same transect and month (seaward +); dry months (Oct-Mar) and monsoon months (Apr-Sep) apart
method.compare_yearly: median Planet position over the dry-season months minus the 2024-25 yearly (tide-averaged) radar position
method.blind: the Phase 14 reference transects and their neighbours are left out of the comparison and hidden in the app
